text:
Sam R: Hey team, Novastar's security lead asked for a short evidence bundle: RBAC snapshot, audit export sample (SIEM field mapping), CMEK rotation attestations for hosted, and HSM policy excerpts for private. Need volunteers.
Ivy C: I can take RBAC snapshot + explain our role mapping. Will produce a CSV with opaque IDs.
Derek M: I'll pull a 72-hour audit sample (jsonl) and include a mapping table: ts, event, actor_id, actor_role, resource, outcome, trace. Will redact user emails.
Lina P: I'll prepare CMEK rotation attestations (signed manifests) and HSM policy snippets for private installs. Quick q: do we deliver raw KMS logs or derived rotation records?
Sam R: Provide derived rotation events (key_id, old_version, new_version, rotated_by(sa id), signature). Offer raw logs under NDA only. Add statement about PII redaction.
Ivy C: putting RBAC CSV in secure share: https://secure-files.redwood.example/novastar/rbac.csv. Replaced emails with svc-ids.
Derek M: example jq I used to trim fields: 
```
jq -c '{ts: .timestamp, event: .event_type, actor_id: .actor.id, resource: .resource.id, outcome: .result}' audit-2025-03-01.jsonl | head -n 200
```
Derek M: will include small sample (200 lines) and a README mapping to their SIEM.
Lina P: attaching signed rotation manifest (will redact operator PII). We sign manifests with our artifact key and include sha256.
Sam R: timeline: can we get draft bundle in 3 business days, final under NDA in 7? Propose triage ack within 48h.
Ivy C: 3bd for draft sounds good.
Derek M: 👍 48h ack works.
Lina P: noted. I'll also add a short runbook snippet showing how to reproduce the export and the verification command: 
```
./tools/export_audit --tenant novastar --since 2025-02-25 --format jsonl > novastar-audit-sample.jsonl
sha256sum novastar-audit-sample.jsonl > novastar-audit-sample.sha256
```
Sam R: evidence-bot, create task to track this bundle.
evidence-bot: created EVID-10456 "novastar evidence bundle" assigned Sam R, Ivy C, Derek M, Lina P. due 2025-03-12.
Sam R: Thanks all — I'll draft the questionnaire answers and attach these artifacts once uploaded. Ping here if any blockers.
